transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As you know, I'm reviewing the operating charter for our weekly cross-team planning forum. Several participants have raised concerns that the current open-discussion format makes it hard to speak up, and there's no consistent advance-notice standard or designated neutral facilitator right now. Before I finalize any revised format, I want to hear from each regular participant and the meeting coordinator. So I'd like to go around and get your input -- what's working, what isn't, and what changes you'd want to see in the new charter.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Leah. I appreciate you checking in with each of us before finalizing. I do have some specific input on what I'd want to see in the revised charter. I have an approved workplace arrangement that sets certain requirements for how group discussions like this forum need to be conducted, and I think it's relevant to share those before we finalize anything. Rather than just mentioning it casually, I want to formally put it on the table so it's properly documented as part of this review process.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thanks, Leah. I'm glad you're going through this review process with everyone. As meeting coordinator, I've been tracking some issues firsthand. I've recorded three occasions just in the last month where participants were publicly interrupted while raising concerns during the forum -- which directly aligns with what people have been telling you about the format making it hard to speak up. I think that's important context for why we need a change. I also want to hear Taylor's input before I lay out my full recommendations, since it sounds like there may be relevant arrangements we should factor into the revised charter.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thanks, Taylor and Morgan. Taylor, I appreciate you wanting to formally put your workplace arrangement on the table -- please go ahead and share the specifics so we can make sure the revised charter properly accounts for it. Morgan, your tracked data on interruptions is exactly the kind of concrete input I need, and I'm glad you want to factor in Taylor's input before giving your full recommendations. Let's hear from Taylor first, then Morgan can lay out the full set of recommendations, and we'll continue around to everyone else. I want to make sure every regular participant and the coordinator has a chance to weigh in before I finalize anything.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My approved workplace arrangement requires the planning forum to use a structured discussion format with a designated neutral facilitator, requires the agenda to be shared at least 48 hours in advance, and prohibits unscripted cold-calling during group discussions. I haven't raised these conditions with you before now because the arrangement is usually handled through my direct manager, but I think it's important they're formally documented as part of this charter review.
